services.name: Raw Water - Standard Analysis
services.summary: Receive a sample-specific baseline water-analysis report; sample point, requested analytes, method, and interpretation scope are confirmed before testing.

services.name: Tower Water - Standard + Bio Counts
services.summary: Receive water-analysis results plus biological counts for the specified cooling-tower sample; collection conditions, method, and interpretation scope are confirmed first.

services.name: Chill Water - Standard + Bio Counts
services.summary: Receive water-analysis results plus biological counts for the specified chilled-water sample; collection conditions, method, and interpretation scope are confirmed first.

services.name: Closed Loop Water - Standard + Bio Counts
services.summary: Receive water-analysis results plus biological counts for the specified closed-loop sample; collection conditions, method, and interpretation scope are confirmed first.

services.name: Steam Boiler Water - Standard
services.summary: Receive a standard result report for the specified boiler-water sample to support program review; analytes, method, and interpretation scope are confirmed first.

services.name: Pretreatment Water (Soft/Degas)
services.summary: Receive a standard result report for the specified softened or degasified pretreatment-water sample; analytes, method, and interpretation scope are confirmed first.

services.name: Boiler Feed Water - Standard
services.summary: Receive a standard result report for the specified boiler-feed sample to support program review; analytes, method, and interpretation scope are confirmed first.

services.name: Polisher Water - Standard
services.summary: Receive a standard result report for the specified polisher-water sample; analytes, method, and interpretation scope are confirmed before testing.

services.name: Steam Condensate - Standard
services.summary: Receive a standard result report for the specified condensate sample to support return-system review; analytes, method, and interpretation scope are confirmed first.

services.name: Biological Counts (HPC/dip-slide)
services.summary: Receive reported HPC or dip-slide count results for the specified sample and method; the result is a program performance indicator, not a measure of illness risk.

services.name: Legionella - Full Culture + Specie ID
services.summary: Receive lab-reported culture and species-identification results for the specified sample; collection plan, turnaround, and interpretation boundary are confirmed first.

services.name: Legionella - PCR Pos/Neg
services.summary: Receive a qualitative PCR result for the specified sample; collection plan, method, turnaround, and interpretation boundary are confirmed first.

services.name: Biological Identifications
services.summary: Receive a reported biological identification for the submitted sample within the agreed method and scope; health-risk conclusions are not included unless separately scoped.

services.name: Corrosion Coupon Analysis (incl. photo)
services.summary: Receive coupon measurements, condition observations, and a photo record for the agreed exposure period; engineering conclusions are separate unless scoped.

services.name: Pipe Analysis (Deposit + Measurements + Photos)
services.summary: Receive deposit observations, pipe measurements, and a photo record for the submitted section; destructive work, sample return, and recommendations are confirmed in scope.

services.name: Deposit Analysis - Standard
services.summary: Receive an analytical result summary for the submitted deposit within the agreed method; source diagnosis and treatment recommendations are separate unless scoped.

services.name: Single Element Analysis (ICP or IC)
services.summary: Receive a reported result for one agreed element by ICP or IC; sample matrix, method, and reporting boundary are confirmed before testing.

services.name: Abbreviated Analysis (ICP or IC)
services.summary: Receive a bounded ICP or IC screening report for agreed targets; full characterization and engineering interpretation are separate unless scoped.

services.name: Water Treatment Bid Specification Creation
services.summary: Receive a draft water-treatment specification built from the supplied system inventory, operating needs, evaluation criteria, and required evidence.

services.name: Water Treatment Bid Review
services.summary: Receive marked-up specification findings and decision notes against the supplied operating needs, incumbent scope, evaluation criteria, and deadline.

services.name: Water Treatment Bid Interview
services.summary: Receive structured interview preparation and decision notes tied to the supplied solicitation and evaluation criteria; participation does not imply eligibility or award.

services.name: Consulting Services (general)
services.summary: Receive a bounded technical working session or memo addressing one defined operating decision; field work, testing, and implementation are separate unless scoped.

services.name: Equipment Inspections
services.summary: Receive documented condition observations, available measurements, and a photo record for the agreed asset and access scope, followed by a findings handoff.

services.name: Ultrasonic / Borescope Testing
services.summary: Receive recorded ultrasonic measurements or borescope observations for the agreed asset locations; access, isolation, and interpretation limits are confirmed first.

services.name: Scanning Electron Microscope Testing
services.summary: Receive microscope imagery and observed-feature reporting for the submitted sample; preparation, sample return, and interpretation boundary are confirmed first.

services.name: Sprinkler System Testing
services.summary: Receive test observations and results for the agreed sprinkler-system scope; access, method, and any regulatory-use boundary are confirmed before work.

services.name: Particle Size Analysis
services.summary: Receive a particle-size result report for the submitted sample and agreed method; identification and source diagnosis are not included unless scoped.

services.name: Particle Size Analysis + Particle ID
services.summary: Receive particle-size results plus identification within the agreed analytical method; source diagnosis and engineering recommendations are separate unless scoped.

services.name: On-Site Sample Collection (travel quoted)
services.summary: Receive a site collection record, labeled samples, and the agreed chain-of-custody handoff; access, travel, containers, preservation, and lab work are confirmed first.

services.name: On-Site Sampling Fee (standard visit)
services.summary: Receive collection of the agreed sample set during a standard visit plus a sample record; site access, travel boundary, and lab testing are confirmed separately.

services.name: Risk Assessment (ASHRAE 188)
services.summary: Receive a building- and system-specific risk assessment documenting the system inventory, risk factors, and control priorities against the agreed ASHRAE 188 project scope.

services.name: WMP Development (ASHRAE 188)
services.summary: Receive a building-specific written plan defining the program team, control locations and limits, monitoring, corrective actions, records, and review cadence.

services.name: Plan Certification
services.summary: Receive a MASEST-issued plan review statement against the agreed project scope; this is not government, ASHRAE, CDC, or third-party accreditation.

services.name: Plan Renewal (annual)
services.summary: Receive an annual plan review and updated document reflecting supplied system changes, program records, findings, and agreed corrective actions.

services.name: Monthly Dashboard Access
services.summary: Receive monthly dashboard access for agreed program records and monitoring status; data entry, alert, review, and follow-up ownership are confirmed in scope.

service_packages.name: Initial Sampling Visit Package
service_packages.summary: Receive a scoped initial visit, collection record, and agreed samples routed for selected testing; travel, lab methods, and turnaround are confirmed before scheduling.

service_packages.name: Water Management Plan Setup (annual)
service_packages.summary: Receive an annual setup engagement covering risk review, plan development, implementation handoff, and the agreed first-year review cadence for the building and systems.

service_packages.name: Quarterly Audit
service_packages.summary: Receive a quarterly program-record review, findings, action list, and owner handoff against the agreed Water Management Plan scope.

service_packages.name: Yearly Recertification
service_packages.summary: Receive an annual MASEST review statement plus identified plan updates against the agreed program scope; this is not government, ASHRAE, CDC, or third-party accreditation.
